The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of the work:

## What was broken and what I implemented

**`modules/byte_program.py`** (was `NotImplementedError` stubs) — implemented the compressed byte layer:
- A shared **rope DAG** (`Leaf`/`Rep`/`Cat`) with weight-balanced merging, so billion-byte captures and repeated boundary probes are never expanded. Every node caches its exact length and exact fingerprint (`sum((b[i]+1)*257^(N-1-i)) mod 2^64`), including O(1) range/prefix hashing through a geometric-series trick and block-indexed leaf prefix tables.
- The **expression compiler**: `ast.parse(mode="eval")` as supplied, AST depth ≤ 128 counting slice/operator/context edges, byte-sequence `+`, `*` with an integer (either order), integer-literal slices with `0<=lo<=hi<=length`, str literals encoded as UTF-8, and a final result that must be bytes.
- The **template compiler**: whole-expression `{{…}}` templates and `<<random_string>>` replaced by `sha256(seed/coordinate/occurrence)[:20]`.

**`modules/capture_audit.py`** (was a stub) — full HTTP/1.1 origin framing: CRLF line rules (8192/8193/8194 boundaries), block size ≤ 65536 and ≤ 128 fields, `Content-Length` list rules, single `chunked` transfer-encoding, chunk-size lines with suffixes, trailer blocks with forbidden names, `syntax`/`incomplete` errors with the uncommitted request offset, per-part `committed` counts, byte-accurate owner/`owners` attribution, and the request/case evidence flags.

**Integration repairs**: the client no longer hangs when a response ends *before* the send finishes (now `ok` at send-finish), the close interrupts paused senders, send-side close rules and datagram `End_Stream` handling are honoured, receipts are exact (`time|stream|kind|content|end`), and `main.py` validates the whole document strictly (duplicate keys, surrogates, nonfinite numbers, unknown keys, every budget) before executing anything.

## Verification
- Public checker: **PASS**.
- Independent reference parsers/simulators cross-checked against the implementation on **~13 000 randomised inputs** (captures, client replays, expressions) — zero mismatches (this found and fixed a real slicing bug inside repetitions).
- Boundary/limit suites for lines, blocks, fields, chunk lines, request budgets, case flags and every documented rejection path.
- Stress runs (20 000 requests, 40 000 chunk lines, 50 000 frames, 8 MiB inputs, GB-scale compressed captures) complete in ~1.5 s and ~70 MB, well inside the scored limits.
